packages.scope: LTM builds a reconciled baseline of technology spend by category, owner and service from the client's ledger and supporting sources, and agrees allocation rules with finance. It includes material business-led spend. It does not change the client's ledger, chart of accounts or tooling.
packages.outcome: A reconciled baseline with documented gaps, an agreed allocation model and a named owner for each spend line.
prerequisites: Evidence for F-001 (Technology spend baseline is not sufficiently transparent), to be supplied by the client before work starts: enterprise spend ledger or equivalent; major technology category totals; owner/service mapping.

Evidence for F-002 (Technology cost allocation is not sufficiently actionable), to be supplied by the client before work starts: allocation rules; service/product ownership mapping; cost-driver or unit-economics evidence.
Named client sponsor and a nominated data owner for each evidence item
Read access to the general ledger extract and procurement or accounts-payable data for the agreed period

workstreams.name: Scope and data collection

Collect ledger, payroll, contract and invoice extracts
Collect business-led spend sources (departmental budgets, card and expense data)
Log each source with owner and completeness
kpis: Share of in-scope entities with an extract received

workstreams.name: Reconcile and classify
activities: Map ledger accounts to a technology cost taxonomy
Reconcile totals to the audited or management accounts
Classify spend by category, owner and service
List unreconciled items and business-led spend found outside central IT
kpis: Unreconciled amount as a share of the total, tracked weekly
Spend lines with a named owner

workstreams.name: Allocation model
activities: Review cost drivers for shared and platform services
Draft allocation rules (direct, driver-based, fixed)
Test the rules on one period and compare with owner expectations
Document unit-cost candidates where evidence supports them
workstreams.ownerRole: Head of technology finance and service owners
kpis: Share of spend allocated by an agreed rule

workstreams.name: Operating rhythm and handover
activities: Define the monthly baseline refresh and owners
Write the data dictionary and reconciliation procedure
Present findings and gaps to the CIO and CFO
kpis: Refresh completed by the client on the agreed date without LTM support

risks.mitigation: Log gaps in the data register, state their effect on the baseline, and agree a date after which the baseline is issued with the gap shown
CIO and CFO sponsor sends the request; the baseline shows unconfirmed spend separately

steps: Extract technology-related ledger accounts for the period

Compare the mapped total with the management accounts
Record differences with a reason and owner
playbook.verification: The mapped total agrees with the management accounts, or every difference is listed with a reason.
options: Technology business management or financial planning tool

steps: List departments with their own technology budgets
Search accounts payable and corporate-card data for known technology suppliers

playbook.verification: Each department head has confirmed or corrected the list in writing, and new suppliers found in payables are on the register.

steps: Choose one shared service and its cost driver
Allocate one period by the draft rule
Review the result with the service owner
Adjust or record the disagreement
playbook.verification: The service owner has seen the allocated figures and accepted the rule or logged an objection.
options: Allocation features in a cost-management platform

packages.scope: LTM designs and starts a governance forum with decision rights, challenge criteria and a stop-or-reduce process for technology spend, including business-led spend. LTM facilitates the first cycles. The client holds the decision rights; LTM does not approve or cancel spend.
packages.outcome: A running forum with charter, thresholds, a decision log and at least one completed challenge cycle.
prerequisites: Evidence for F-003 (Low-value technology spend is not consistently challenged), to be supplied by the client before work starts: portfolio governance decisions; spend challenge/stop history; investment/value thresholds.

Evidence for F-017 (Business-led technology spend is not fully governed), to be supplied by the client before work starts: business-led spend inventory; ownership/governance model; procurement/billing evidence.
Named client sponsor and a nominated data owner for each evidence item
Executive sponsor with authority to chair the forum
